outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a quantitative plot.
Panel B shows H&E histology micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

The top box plot of total polyp number is exempt from this check (box plots already show distribution). However, the bottom 3D bar chart shows mean polyp numbers per genotype broken down by polyp diameter without overlaying the individual per-mouse data points, even though the caption indicates variable sample sizes (n=8–18 per genotype).
Panel D is a Kaplan–Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.

The immunoblot images are not quantitative plots, but the accompanying bar graph of relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels with error bars shows only averaged values without the underlying individual data points.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

The immunoblots and zymography images are not plots, but the bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers shows only group averages without the individual data points behind them.
